title: For-profit entity; after conversion.
bodyText: After conversion, the for-profit entity shall not be subject to this chapter, but if a stock insurance company, shall be in conformance with title 24.
bodyHtml: [§432C-6]  For-profit entity; after conversion.  After conversion, the for-profit entity shall not be subject to this chapter, but if a stock insurance company, shall be in conformance with title 24. [L 1998, c 260, pt of §2]
